title: Cryopods
subtitle: Sleep, and wake up on the ship
text:
A Cryopod Bed is a bed. Sleep in it and it becomes your spawn point, even in places where a normal bed would explode.

A Start Cryopod (in the creative tab) marks where new players wake up the first time they join. Map makers can also use /simplemachines startpod on a placed cryopod bed.

The tall Cryopod is decoration with a sleeper inside. Use /simplemachines pod with a player name, a UUID or skin:crew_1 to choose who is in it. Pods placed by a structure pick a sleeper from the occupant list in the data pack and config.
